nodes.data: The break-before rule with a following whitespace-separated sibling (non-terminal): the element breaks to a fresh line and lays out block-style (content too long to collapse); the terminal trailing text ` tail` hugs the intact ``. Prettier keeps the opening tag on the text line and dangles it — see prettier_variant_dangle.svelte.
